cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

mechanism: A exercises assumed final say over a requested favor by setting and adjusting its impossible symbolic price rather than negotiating ordinary payment.
confusable: Generic surreal rule invention is confusable: each strange item must pay for a specific favor and A must control which tender or terms B may use.
comparison: The ladder alternative converts a material loan into protective emotional collateral; the kettle alternative treats a timing objection as a request for credit terms.
seedUse: Both canonical Stance seeds and both Drive seeds read. Preserve shadow labor and maturing time currency as creative context, but make approval of payment terms cause A responses.
